def: Geospatial Intelligence — imagery, IMINT, and geospatial information used together.
Imagery Intelligence — intelligence derived from interpretation of imagery.
Synthetic Aperture Radar — radar imagery providing all-weather, day-night coverage.
Full-Motion / Wide-Area Motion Imagery — persistent or area video products.
Signals intelligence from non-communications emitters (radars, beacons).
Signals intelligence from communications between persons.
Line of Sight — required for most RF, optical, and IR sensing.
Man-Portable Air Defense System — typically IR-guided.
Military Information Support Operations — influence intent.
Deliberately false information shared to deceive.
Inaccurate information shared without intent to deceive.
Priority Intelligence Requirement — commander's top intel need.
Actions to deny, degrade, disrupt, destroy, or deceive space capabilities. Kinetic or non-kinetic.
